integrity: All critical calculations are reconstructible from an embedded exact-arithmetic script; nonproof simulation clearly separate. The known mixed-moment method and motivating model are fully credited; possible unindexed equivalent analysis is a residual novelty risk.
scientific_limitations: Instantaneous probe-only Poisson resetting of one linear thermal Brownian bath; relative variability is for per-reset signed spring-energy change, not full physical implementation or accumulated work. Stationarity precedes bath-parameter limits. Double-extremum interval restricted to reset rates from one-half through three-fifths. Independent audit absent.
title: A sharp reset-rate threshold and reentrant spring-energy fluctuations in a retained-memory Brownian bath
